hausregeln.title: House Rules
hausregeln.description: A few simple rules for a harmonious stay – thank you for keeping to them.
hausregeln.heading: Welcome – we're glad you're here!
hausregeln.intro: So that everyone feels comfortable – guests and neighbors alike – we kindly ask you to keep the following in mind:

rules.name: Respect & Consideration
rules.description: Please treat the other guests and our neighbors with consideration and respect. That way everyone feels at home.

rules.name: Observe Quiet Hours
rules.description: In Baden-Württemberg, quiet hours apply from 22:00 to 08:00. Please avoid noise during this time so the neighborhood can rest undisturbed.

rules.name: Waste Dates & Bins
rules.description: Please note the waste collection dates and place the relevant bins out by the curb in good time – ideally the evening before. You can find the collection days on the “Waste Collection” page.

rules.name: Smoke-Free Apartment
rules.description: Smoking inside the apartments is not permitted – as also stated in the rental contract. Please use the outdoor area if you wish to smoke.

verkehr.heading: Getting around by bus & train
verkehr.intro: The apartment on Lange Straße sits right in the heart of Oßweil. Several VVS bus lines stop just a few minutes' walk away and take you to Ludwigsburg's central bus station (ZOB), the train station or the U12 light rail to Stuttgart.

stadtbahn.heading: To Stuttgart on the U12 light rail
stadtbahn.name: U12 light rail from Remseck
stadtbahn.description: The SSB U12 light rail starts in Remseck (Neckargröningen) and runs about every 10 minutes during the day straight into central Stuttgart – no changes needed to reach the main station and Schlossplatz. From Oßweil, reach Remseck with bus line 431.
points: Bus 431 from Oßweil to Remseck, then change directly to the U12
The U12 runs via Bad Cannstatt and the main station to Schlossplatz
Roughly every 10 minutes during the day
stadtbahn.urlLabel: More about the U12 at SSB
stadtbahn.imageAlt: Illustration of a U12 light rail vehicle

bahnhof.heading: Ludwigsburg station – S-Bahn & rail
bahnhof.name: Ludwigsburg station
bahnhof.description: Ludwigsburg station is the region's central hub. The S-Bahn gets you to Stuttgart main station in about 15 minutes. From Oßweil, reach the station with bus 425 via the ZOB.
points: S4 & S5 run every 15 minutes to Stuttgart during the day
Regional and long-distance trains (incl. IC/ICE) towards Heilbronn, Würzburg and Karlsruhe
Numerous regional bus lines right in front of the station

tickets.heading: Tickets & fares
tickets.description: Bus, light rail and S-Bahn all belong to the VVS network – one ticket covers the whole journey. Oßweil and Ludwigsburg are in fare zone 3, Stuttgart in zone 1.
points: Single ticket, day ticket or the handy mobile ticket in the VVS app
For trips to Stuttgart, the group day ticket is worth it
